Bland-Altman plots of a reliability analysis

Source: R/MFO_reliability.R
plot.MFO_reliability.Rd

Difference against mean of one pair of consecutive sessions, with the bias and the limits of agreement, one panel per variable (Bland & Altman 1986).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'MFO_reliability'
plot(x, pair = 1, variables = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

result of [MFO_reliability()].

pair

which pair of consecutive sessions: 1 (default) is S2 - S1, 2 is S3 - S2, and so on.

variables

variables to draw (default all).

...

not used.

Value

A ggplot object.
